tasks.title: Linear nutrient requirements engine, NRC 2001 DMI ceiling, and two-stage LP solver
tasks.description: Create src/domain/requirements.ts reading src/data/requirements.v1.json to compute linear maintenance + per-litre requirement models for CP, ME, Ca, and P, the NRC 2001 Eq. 1-1 dry-matter intake ceiling DM_max(Y) = k0 + kY * Y at week of lactation 20, and the cited roughage minimum share r. Create src/domain/solver.ts using javascript-lp-solver: omit the prototype's 85% DM floor (prototype alignment #2: only the NRC upper ceiling and the homogeneous roughage row sum_{i in R}(1-r)d_i x_i - sum_{i notin R} r d_i x_i >= 0 apply); enforce BINDING_ORDER = ['budget', 'breed_cap', 'intake', 'roughage', 'CP', 'ME', 'Ca', 'P'] evaluated on the Stage 2 solution at Y* (prototype alignment #3); run (1) Maintenance LP at Y=0 with infeasibility diagnosis for nutrients, roughage (AC-E2.2), or DM conflict and priced-feed suggestions (AC-E2.1), (2) Budget below maintenance check suggesting only unselected feeds with a non-null default price (AC-E7.1), (3) Dry animal shortcut at T=0 returning the maintenance ration and dry_animal verdict (AC-5.13), (4) Stage 1 max milk Y* <= max(breedCap, T) within budget, (5) Stage 2 min cost at Y* (binding detection) and at S = floor(10 * Y* + 1e-7) / 10 (displayed ration), (6) Stage 2' at T without budget cap for B and Z, and (7) double-precision numerical verification within 1e-6. Align BINDING_ORDER in src/services/mockSolver.ts. Create tests/unit/requirements.test.ts and tests/unit/verdict.test.ts, and expand tests/unit/solver.test.ts.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: SPEC AC-2.1, AC-5.1, AC-5.2, AC-5.3, AC-5.4, AC-5.5, AC-5.6, AC-5.7, AC-5.8, AC-5.9, AC-5.10, AC-5.11, AC-5.12, AC-5.13, AC-E2.1, AC-E2.2, AC-E7.1: npx vitest run tests/unit/requirements.test.ts tests/unit/solver.test.ts tests/unit/verdict.test.ts verifies closed-form k0 and kY against NRC 2001 Eq. 1-1, Stage 1 and Stage 2 optimality, S <= Y* <= max(cap, T), one test case per binding constraint in BINDING_ORDER ('budget', 'breed_cap', 'intake', 'roughage', 'CP', 'ME', 'Ca', 'P') with only that constraint tight, roughage DM >= r * total DM within 1e-6, all verdict branches using unrounded Y* vs T, roughage-only and nutrient infeasibility diagnosis, and below-maintenance fix suggestions excluding unpriced feeds.

tasks.title: Client-side explanation number verifier, Devanagari language gate, and authorized number collector
tasks.description: Update src/domain/verifier.ts to implement collectAuthorizedNumbers(context) and verifyExplanationNumbers(explanationText, authorizedNumbers). collectAuthorizedNumbers gathers all numeric values displayed or used in the run: animal inputs (bodyWeightKg, milkYieldLitersPerDay, milkFatPct, budgetInrPerDay), breed figures (milkCapLPerDay, fatPctLow, fatPctHigh), nutrient requirements at S, and solver outputs (supportedMilkLPerDay S, effectiveCapLPerDay, maintenanceCostInrPerDay M, costAtTodayMilkInrPerDay B, verdict gainLPerDay X or savingInrPerDay Z, totalKgAsFed, totalCostInr, underBudgetInr, currentCostInr, savingsInr, savingsPct, roughageSharePct, roughageMinSharePct, per-feed kgAsFed/costInr/priceInrPerKg, supplied nutrients, and coveragePct). verifyExplanationNumbers first checks the language gate (any Devanagari character U+0900..U+097F in explanationText fails verification per AC-L1.6), then parses all numeric tokens and verifies each token v against authorized set A within |v - a| <= max(0.05, 0.01 * |a|) or matching rounded values at 0, 1, or 2 decimal places. Create tests/unit/verifier.test.ts.

tasks.title: Serverless OpenRouter proxy (api/llm.ts) with model fallback chain and nutrient safety
tasks.description: Create api/llm.ts implementing POST /api/llm for action: 'extract' and action: 'explain'. Read OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL (default meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free), and comma-separated OPENROUTER_FALLBACK_MODELS from server environment variables. On HTTP 429, 5xx, or upstream timeout, automatically retry across the fallback chain. For 'extract': validate freeText (1-1000 chars), instruct the model to parse English, Hindi, or Hinglish descriptions (bhains -> buffalo, gaay -> cow, kilo -> kg, doodh -> milk, rupaye roz -> budgetInrPerDay) and match feed and breed names only against the provided catalog and breeds lists, strip any breedId not in the species breed list, place unknown feeds in unmatchedFeeds, and never accept or emit nutrient, price, season, or breed-cap numbers (AC-E5.1). For 'explain': prompt for a concise plain-English factual explanation (no Devanagari, no veterinary advice) using only the provided authorizedNumbers (and on attempt 2 explicitly forbidding flaggedNumbers). Return structured error codes (RATE_LIMITED, UPSTREAM_ERROR, TIMEOUT, INVALID_REQUEST). Create tests/unit/llmProxy.test.ts.
